title: Relationship Between Controllability Scoring and Optimal Experimental Design
summary: Controllability scores provide control-theoretic centrality measures that quantify the relative importance of state nodes in networked dynamical systems. We establish a structural connection between finite-time controllability scoring and approximate optimal experimental design (OED): the finite-time controllability Gramian decomposes additively across nodes, yielding an affine matrix model of the same form as the information-matrix model in OED.
